# Everything Embroidered

> Family-owned custom embroidery, monogramming and printing shop in Paramus Park Mall, Paramus, New Jersey. Open for over 18 years. Serves individuals, families, schools, teams and businesses in Paramus, Bergen County and the greater New Jersey area.

## Quick facts
- Name: Everything Embroidered
- Address: 700 Paramus Park, Paramus, NJ 07662 (inside Paramus Park Mall)
- Phone / text: (201) 916-3221
- Email: everythingembroidered@hotmail.com
- Hours: same as Paramus Park Mall's hours
- Services: custom embroidery, monogramming, screen printing, glitter and specialty decoration (e.g. Christmas stockings, hats), personalized gifts, team and corporate apparel, bulk orders
- Customers can bring their own items to be customized
- Large and bulk orders welcome; clients have included Starbucks, AT&T and Camp Ramaquois
- Refunds/exchanges: purchases are final unless the shop made a mistake
- Quotes: free; request by phone/text or the form at https://eembroidered.com/contact
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/everythingembroidered11
